Read “Structural Diagram of the Shouguang Vegetable Industry Cluster”.

<image1>

The clustered production of Shouguang vegetables causes related auxiliary industries and service departments to be derived and clustered. According to the diagram, one type that belongs to upstream enterprises of vegetable production is ________.
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the "Shouguang Vegetable Industry Cluster Structure Diagram". <image1> The clustered production of vegetables in Shouguang causes related auxiliary industries and service departments to derive and cluster. According to the diagram, one type of upstream enterprise in vegetable production is ________.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the center of the diagram is the oval-shaped “vegetable production base”, with multiple associated entities around it. On the left side, “intermediary service organizations”, “seed and seedling companies”, “agricultural production materials enterprises”, “scientific research and training institutions”, etc. can be seen in sequence; on the right side there are “farmers” and “leading vegetable enterprises”; below there is the “government”. These entities have connecting lines with the “vegetable production base”. Then reason: The question stem requires finding “one type that belongs to upstream enterprises of vegetable production”. Upstream enterprises of vegetable production are enterprises that provide production inputs for the vegetable production base; the “agricultural production materials enterprises” in the diagram provide the materials needed for production and belong to upstream enterprises. Therefore, “agricultural production materials enterprises” should be filled in.

raw_record.question_text:
Read “Structural Diagram of the Shouguang Vegetable Industry Cluster”.

<image1>

The clustered production of Shouguang vegetables causes related auxiliary industries and service departments to be derived and clustered. According to the diagram, one type that belongs to upstream enterprises of vegetable production is ________.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像结构：图中央是“蔬菜生产基地”，周围有多个关联主体，左侧有“种子及种苗公司”“农业生产资料企业”等，右侧有农户和蔬菜加工企业。再读题干，要求找“属于蔬菜生产上游企业的一类”。用产业链知识判断，上游企业是为蔬菜生产基地提供生产投入的企业，因此图中“农业生产资料企业”属于蔬菜生产的上游企业，填“农业生产资料企业”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中央是椭圆形的“蔬菜生产基地”，周围有多个关联主体。左侧依次可见“中介服务组织”“种子及种苗公司”“农业生产资料企业”“科研、培训机构”等，右侧有“农户”和“蔬菜龙头企业”，下方有“政府”，这些主体与“蔬菜生产基地”之间有连线。再推理：题干要求找“属于蔬菜生产上游企业的一类”。蔬菜生产的上游企业是为蔬菜生产基地提供生产投入的企业；图中的“农业生产资料企业”提供生产所需资料，属于上游企业。因此应填“农业生产资料企业”。

method.CoT_qualify_0: 通过。推理链先描述图像、再根据题干和产业链知识判断，顺序符合要求；图中主体名称和位置基本可由图像直接验证，最终答案与标准答案“农业生产资料企业”一致。可微调之处：若强调“上游企业”可同时说明图中还有“种子及种苗公司”也属于上游，但本题该空按标准答案填写“农业生产资料企业”即可。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: 直接依据产业链上下游含义与图中节点位置/连线判断，是本题最自然且唯一强区分的解法。
planner_metadata.image_role: 从图中读取中心节点为“蔬菜生产基地”，其左侧与生产基地相连的相关部门包括“中介服务组织”“种子及种苗公司”“农业生产资料企业”“科研、培训机构”等；其中“农业生产资料企业”向蔬菜生产提供生产投入。
planner_metadata.text_role: 题干限定材料为“寿光蔬菜产业集群结构图”，并明确询问“属于蔬菜生产上游企业的一类”，需要从图示相关主体中选出符合上游属性的企业类别。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 产业链上游指位于核心生产环节之前、为生产提供原料、设备、种苗、农资等投入的企业；蔬菜生产的农业生产资料如化肥、农药、农膜、农机等属于生产前投入。
